test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

I find playing chess __to be difficult__ than playing poker.
solution:
The solution is **to be more difficult.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The option that will improve the underlined part of "I find playing chess to be difficult__ than playing poker." is to be more difficult.
 
• I find playing chess **to be more difficult** than playing poker.
 
• Here the word "**more**" is added to the sentence because here the game chess is compared with poker.
 
• Hence, to show the difficulty level of playing the game we used **more**.
 
• Therefore **option 1 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
